Runner-side orchestrator for one registered production SQL tool (sql71, sql77, sql78, sql79, sql80, sql81, sql82, sql83, sql84, sql85, sql86, sql87, sql88, sql89). Never connects to a database or AWS itself and never applies SQL: it verifies the transfer tarball, the tree and the migration bytes, then runs the registered tool's --inspect, the registry's accepted contracts, preflight.mjs --acquire-lease --receipt, the tool's evaluate and --apply, and a post-apply --inspect, each as a child process, stopping on the first failure. Refuses a pin with execute false, takes no receipt, manifest or input file, refuses to start with any CHECKSOPS_DEPLOYMENT_GUARD_* or node loader variable or node flag set, binds the tree to --expected-tarball-sha256 and SOURCE_COMMIT and re-compares it before preflight and before apply, gives children only an allowlisted environment, and sets CHECKSOPS_DEPLOYMENT_GUARD_APPLY=1 and the preflight-issued receipt path only for the single apply child. The tool's own enforceScriptGuard, receipt ownership, execute, phrase and one_use_id checks stay authoritative.
